decision: Review 1 forward fix: release.targets now rebinds org.opencontainers.artifact.created with the publisher ContainerProvenanceCreated instant alongside image.created, so plain consumers keep both created labels. The release route of the platform cohort test now requires the instant on every declared-build evaluation and command, and the scope wording names only the evaluations and commands that receive it. The candidate is local, uncommitted and unpushed on the Builds fix branch with no upstream. verification.json stays unchanged as the record of the first implementation; the supersedes list names its entries that are now wrong.

release_blocker.status: fix on Builds main at 99baf1db; releasable once hosted Builds CI passes on it
release_blocker.history: Builds main holds the 7f085bad artifact.created regression (plain consumers lose org.opencontainers.artifact.created). It is untagged so far: after git fetch --tags origin, git tag --contains 7f085bad76da517d85b835f45facd649dfc7bc36 is empty. No central Builds release may be cut from main until this fix lands.

supersedes.reason: it says every image's image.created label carries the instant; after the fix, both image.created and artifact.created carry it on every image
it says the plain container has no artifact.created; that was the regression, and the real multi-RID test now requires both created labels on every child of both containers
the open list omits this forward fix and the release_blocker above, and hosted Builds CI for 7f085bad has since passed (hosted_ci below)
